name: Longjing green tea
where: Meijiawu tea farm shops or official brand stores
about: A famous green tea grown in the hills around West Lake. It is known for its flat leaves and fresh, nutty taste.
tip: Ask for a tasting before you buy. West Lake and Mingqian-harvest certified teas cost much more than regular ones.

name: Hangzhou silk scarf
where: Wensli official store or the China Silk Museum shop
about: Hangzhou has a long history of silk weaving, and this scarf reflects that local craft.
tip: Check the silk content on the label before paying.

name: Zhang Xiaoquan scissors
where: Official Zhang Xiaoquan stores, especially around Hefang Street
about: A traditional metal craft brand from Hangzhou, known for well-made scissors that have been produced for generations.
tip: Pack these in checked luggage, not carry-on, because blades are not allowed in the cabin.
